description: This Java class 'ContactsDictionary' is part of an Android application, implementing a dictionary that loads contact names from the device's contacts database. It manages contact words, their frequencies, and provides next-word suggestions based on contact name parts. It also handles permission requests for reading contacts and processes contact data into a word frequency dictionary for use in a keyboard or text input system.

classes.name: ContactsDictionary
classes.description: A dictionary class that loads contact names from the device's contacts database, manages their frequencies, and provides next-word suggestions based on contact name parts. It handles permission requests, processes contact data, and integrates with the application's notification system.

methods.name: loadAllResources
methods.description: Loads and processes contact name parts and next-word suggestions from internal storage into memory.

methods.name: readWordsFromActualStorage
methods.description: Reads contact names from the device's contacts database, requesting permission if necessary, and feeds the contact names into the dictionary with calculated frequencies.

methods.name: addWordFromStorageToMemory
methods.description: Splits a contact full name into individual words and updates the next-word suggestions map.

methods.name: deleteWordFromStorage
methods.description: Stub method; not supporting deletion of contact words.

methods.name: addWordToStorage
methods.description: Stub method; not supporting addition of contact words.

methods.name: notifyNextTypedWord
methods.description: No operation; not learning in this dictionary.

methods.name: getNextWords
methods.description: Returns a list of next word suggestions based on the current word.

methods.name: resetSentence
methods.description: No operation; no sentence reset needed.
